hero.subtitle: 1000x faster startup than vanilla. 18x less memory. Built with Rust for maximum performance.

features.title: Why developers
features.f1Desc: Server ready in ~5 milliseconds. Not 15 seconds. That's 1000x faster than vanilla.
features.f2Desc: Runs on ~100MB RAM while vanilla needs 1.8GB. Perfect for cheap VPS hosting.
features.f3Desc: Actually uses all your CPU cores. Not just for chunks—for everything.
features.f4Desc: Java and Bedrock players together. Built-in, no plugins required.
features.f5Desc: Single executable file. Download, double-click, done. Zero setup.
features.f6Desc: GPL licensed. Read the code, contribute, fork it. Full transparency.
